title: Visible electrical and plumbing point schedule
source: Mr. Dhairya Ji_Service Plan (2).pdf, physical pages3,5,7,8,11,12,13; revised user instructions
scope: Endpoint visualization. Original plan zones and mounting-height schedule used where supplied. Precise horizontal coordinates, new mumty endpoints and washer services are proposals for installer coordination. No hidden conduit routes, circuit design, pipe falls, pipe sizing or compliance certification.
